st_joseph_litany_collect.text: O God, who in Thine unspeakable providence didst vouchsafe to choose blessed Joseph to be the spouse of Thine own most holy Mother: grant, we beseech Thee, that we may deserve to have him for our intercessor in heaven, whom we reverence as our defender on earth. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
st_joseph_litany_collect.source: The Litany of Saint Joseph (approval of Pius X, 1909); closing collect

schedule_note.note: The received Litany of Saint Joseph — the approved litany of 1909 (indulgenced from the 1860s), not the later 21st-century redaction with its additional invocations: the invocation list is the received 26 invocations ("Holy Mary" through "Protector of Holy Church"). The four Trinitarian invocations are answered "have mercy on us."; the litany block and "Holy Mary" are answered "pray for us."; followed by the Agnus Dei versicles, the "lord of His house" versicle, and the received collect. The session’s versicles are received liturgical formulas (public domain); the collect is a conservative received rendering.
